channel.description: Latest articles from The Lawrence Times (lawrencekstimes.com)

item.title: Kansas Republicans force transgender bathroom restrictions into law, overriding a veto
item.description: Republicans in the Kansas Legislature have forced restrictions on bathroom use by transgender people into state law by overriding the governor’s veto. Continue reading ...

item.title: Kansas disaster declaration prepares state for World Cup visitor boom
item.description: The upcoming World Cup prompted Gov. Laura Kelly to declare a state of disaster emergency in Douglas and two other counties, anticipating effects from four base camps in the Kansas City-area. Continue reading ...

item.title: Report suggests solutions to help single mothers in Douglas County
item.description: Single mothers in Douglas County regularly endure overlapping struggles to find housing, food and health care, according to a report produced by the county, KU and a handful of other local agencies. Continue reading ...

item.title: Amy Helmer: Life, liberty, and the right to pee (Column)
item.description: "Fearmongering over the alleged safety risks of peeing is so deeply American, it is hardly surprising that the modern-day politician increasingly attempts to frame transgender people as political scapegoats," Amy Helmer writes in this column. Continue reading ...

item.title: Kansas House Democrat rebukes Republican’s remarks about ‘filthy’ renters in debate over protections
item.description: Rep. Brooklynne Mosley, of Lawrence, told Kansas House members she would pray for those who favor corporate landlords over renters and lashed out at a Republican who complained about “filthy” renters. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence, Lenexa residents injured in 4-vehicle crash in Johnson County
item.description: A Lawrence resident and a Lenexa resident, ages 21 and 20, were seriously injured in a four-vehicle crash Wednesday on I-435 near the K-10 exit in Johnson County. Continue reading ...

item.title: Haskell students to hold ‘ICE Out’ protest in Lawrence
item.description: Haskell students are organizing a peaceful protest against ICE following the arrests of five Lawerence community members earlier this week. Continue reading ...

item.title: KU announces new provost and chief academic officer
item.description: Arash Mafi, currently dean of KU's College of Liberal Arts and Sciences, has been announced as the university's next provost, and Jennifer Roberts will fill the CLAS dean position. Continue reading ...

item.title: Algeria’s World Cup team chooses Lawrence as base camp
item.description: The city of Lawrence and the University of Kansas will host Algeria’s national team at Rock Chalk Park. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence sober living home expands beds for women in recovery to live with their children, build tenacity
item.description: A renovated historical home in Lawrence has joined Cardinal Housing Network’s transitional housing options for women recovering from substance use, this time allowing residents to live with their children. Continue reading ...
